description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-role-auth-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzhalsanv000 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
